description: OMENZ Domain Check: should your agent trust this domain before paying it or emailing it? Registration age and expiry (RDAP), registrar and registry status, does it resolve, can it receive mail (MX), SPF and DMARC (can others spoof it?). RED_FLAGS if unregistered, not resolving, on hold or registered < 30 days ago; CAUTION if young, expiring, or missing mail/anti-spoofing records; LOOKS_ESTABLISHED otherwise. Subdomains are checked against their registered domain. Public data (RDAP + DNS-over-HTTPS), no keys. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/domain/check, $0.003 via x402.)
name: domain_check
